channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight widespread critical risks across web security, cloud infrastructure, and IoT ecosystems, characterized primarily by remote code execution and authentication bypasses. Notable incidents include privilege escalation flaws in Kubernetes controllers such as Kyverno and Kubero, unauthenticated RCE in consumer networking hardware from vendors like TOTOLINK and Linksys, and injection attacks targeting identity platforms including Keycloak and IBM MQ. Furthermore, significant deserialization vulnerabilities and supply chain risks were detected in middleware and development tools, emphasizing persistent threats to data integrity and system access controls.
